VrijeRuimte_PaternRecognition_HondVsKat

Vrije Opdracht Toepassing

Honden VS Katten herkenning

In deze opdracht bouw ik een convolutional neural network (CNN) om katten en honden te classificeren op basis van dataset aan afbeeldingen.

# hier zorg ik er voor dat alle onbruikbare/verouderde afbeeldingen worden opgeschoont.
dataset_path <- "/home/dani.pfeijffer/Workflows/Workflows_Portfolio/Opdracht_2_Vrije_Opdracht/Data/Training"

files <- list.files(dataset_path, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

bad_files <- c()

for (f in files) {
  img <- try(readJPEG(f), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(img, "try-error")) {
    bad_files <- c(bad_files, f)
  }
}
## Warning in readJPEG(f): JPEG decompression: Warning: unknown JFIF revision
## number 0.00
if (length(bad_files) > 0) {
  file.remove(bad_files)
}
# Het dataset maken

train_ds <- image_dataset_from_directory(
  dataset_path,
  image_size = c(64, 64),
  batch_size = 32,
  validation_split = 0.2,
  subset = "training",
  seed = 123
)
## Found 24769 files belonging to 2 classes.
## Using 19816 files for training.
val_ds <- image_dataset_from_directory(
  dataset_path,
  image_size = c(64, 64),
  batch_size = 32,
  validation_split = 0.2,
  subset = "validation",
  seed = 123
)
## Found 24769 files belonging to 2 classes.
## Using 4953 files for validation.
# visualisatie van de data/afbeeldingen

iterator <- as_iterator(train_ds)
batch <- reticulate::iter_next(iterator)

images <- batch[[1]]
labels <- batch[[2]]

par(mfrow = c(3,3))

for (i in 1:9) {
  img <- images[i,,,]
  plot(as.raster(img / 255))
  title(main = ifelse(labels[i] == 0, "Cat", "Dog"))}

# Het maaken van de modellen

model <- keras_model_sequential() %>%
  layer_rescaling(scale = 1/255, input_shape = c(64, 64, 3)) %>%
  layer_conv_2d(filters = 32, kernel_size = 3, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_max_pooling_2d() %>%
  layer_conv_2d(filters = 64, kernel_size = 3, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_max_pooling_2d() %>%
  layer_flatten() %>%
  layer_dense(units = 64, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_dense(units = 1, activation = "sigmoid")

summary(model)
## Model: "sequential"
## ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┳━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┳━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓
## ┃ Layer (type)                      ┃ Output Shape             ┃       Param # ┃
## ┡━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━╇━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━╇━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┩
## │ rescaling (Rescaling)             │ (None, 64, 64, 3)        │             0 │
## ├───────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────┼───────────────┤
## │ conv2d (Conv2D)                   │ (None, 62, 62, 32)       │           896 │
## ├───────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────┼───────────────┤
## │ max_pooling2d (MaxPooling2D)      │ (None, 31, 31, 32)       │             0 │
## ├───────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────┼───────────────┤
## │ conv2d_1 (Conv2D)                 │ (None, 29, 29, 64)       │        18,496 │
## ├───────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────┼───────────────┤
## │ max_pooling2d_1 (MaxPooling2D)    │ (None, 14, 14, 64)       │             0 │
## ├───────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────┼───────────────┤
## │ flatten (Flatten)                 │ (None, 12544)            │             0 │
## ├───────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────┼───────────────┤
## │ dense (Dense)                     │ (None, 64)               │       802,880 │
## ├───────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────┼───────────────┤
## │ dense_1 (Dense)                   │ (None, 1)                │            65 │
## └───────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┴───────────────┘
##  Total params: 822,337 (3.14 MB)
##  Trainable params: 822,337 (3.14 MB)
##  Non-trainable params: 0 (0.00 B)
model %>% compile(
  optimizer = "adam",
  loss = "binary_crossentropy",
  metrics = c("accuracy"))

model %>% fit(train_ds, validation_data = val_ds, epochs = 5, verbose = 2)
## Epoch 1/5
## 620/620 - 13s - 21ms/step - accuracy: 0.6661 - loss: 0.5998 - val_accuracy: 0.7458 - val_loss: 0.5159
## Epoch 2/5
## 620/620 - 11s - 18ms/step - accuracy: 0.7714 - loss: 0.4715 - val_accuracy: 0.7640 - val_loss: 0.4890
## Epoch 3/5
## 620/620 - 12s - 19ms/step - accuracy: 0.8090 - loss: 0.4099 - val_accuracy: 0.7892 - val_loss: 0.4464
## Epoch 4/5
## 620/620 - 12s - 19ms/step - accuracy: 0.8402 - loss: 0.3563 - val_accuracy: 0.8019 - val_loss: 0.4280
## Epoch 5/5
## 620/620 - 12s - 19ms/step - accuracy: 0.8681 - loss: 0.3032 - val_accuracy: 0.8019 - val_loss: 0.4562
# nu we het model getraint hebben gaan we kijken naar de tsest data set. en wat de accuracy/loss daarvan is.
score <- model %>% evaluate(val_ds, verbose = 0)

cat("Validation loss:", score[["loss"]], "\n")
## Validation loss: 0.456239
cat("Validation accuracy:", score[["accuracy"]], "\n")
## Validation accuracy: 0.8019382
# voorspelling doen met een afbeelding waarbij dichter bij de 1 de hond is en 0 de kat
predictions <- model %>% predict(val_ds)
## 155/155 - 1s - 7ms/step
predictions[1, ]
## [1] 0.004596996
predicted_label <- ifelse(predictions[1, ] > 0.5, 1, 0)
predicted_label
## [1] 0
#visualisatie van de voorspellingen.

iterator <- as_iterator(val_ds)
batch <- reticulate::iter_next(iterator)

images <- batch[[1]]
labels <- batch[[2]]

predictions <- model %>% predict(images[1,,, drop = FALSE])
## Warning in `[.tensorflow.tensor`(images, 1, , , drop = FALSE): Incorrect number
## of dimensions supplied. The number of supplied arguments, (not counting any
## NULL, tf$newaxis or np$newaxis) must match thenumber of dimensions in the
## tensor, unless an all_dims() was supplied (this will produce an error in the
## future)
## 1/1 - 0s - 70ms/step
predictions
##           [,1]
## [1,] 0.7541547
predicted_label <- ifelse(predictions[1, ] > 0.5, 1, 0)
predicted_label
## [1] 1
par(mfrow = c(3,3), mar = c(1,1,2,1))

iterator <- as_iterator(val_ds)
batch <- reticulate::iter_next(iterator)

images <- batch[[1]]
labels <- batch[[2]]

predictions <- model %>% predict(images)
## 1/1 - 0s - 78ms/step
for (i in 1:9) {
  img <- images[i,,,]
  pred_value <- predictions[i, 1]
  pred_label <- ifelse(pred_value > 0.5, 1, 0)
  true_label <- as.numeric(labels[i])
  col <- ifelse(pred_label == true_label, "darkgreen", "red")
  plot(as.raster(img / 255))
  title(
    main = paste0(
      ifelse(pred_label == 1, "Dog", "Cat"),
      " (", round(pred_value, 2), ")"
    ),
    col.main = col
  )
}
